description: One-on-one meeting agenda — Plan a manager-employee 1:1 (weekly, biweekly, career, first, skip-level or feedback): agenda items with owner, minutes and questions, openers, signals to watch for and action-item prompts. Offline: last meeting's action items carried over first, minutes allocated exactly to the meeting length, employee time share (flag under 50%), missing wrap-up flag, next meeting date on a business day, and a markdown agenda with time stamps. Params: context (required), kind, minutes=30, last (items separated by ;), date=YYYY-MM-DD. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

context.description: e.g. new backend engineer in week 3, struggling with on-call
